instruction: Fix `aggregate` in `datastore/query.py` so it returns the `default` value when the input is empty. It currently calls `func` on an empty list, which raises for `min`/`max` instead of falling back to `default`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore/query.py b/datastore/query.py
--- a/datastore/query.py
+++ b/datastore/query.py
@@ -45,6 +45,8 @@
     Returns ``default`` when there are no records.
     """
     values = [record[key] for record in records]
+    if not values:
+        return default
     return func(values)
